title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：status　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 status 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the clerk ① earned the status that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the earning was the whole of the month. The ② status, meaning the rank itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; status, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of status in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ status at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Status, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the status was the whole of the matter, meaning the respect and not the rank. The ⑥ status, meaning the respect and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; status, he said, is either something you earn or the only word that means both rank and a respect. He said the respect is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ status had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ status of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; status, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ status I remember is the status described in the file, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Status, my mother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being described; all status, she said, is a respect that has agreed to look like rank. She said the respect was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地位；身份（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 地位；身份（指那种地位本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：earn the status 挣得这一种地位
D. n. 地位；身份（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 地位之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的地位之事）
F. n. 地位；身份（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 地位、体面（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体面（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: earned the status that no applicant in the office would have described
The status, meaning the rank itself and not the stamp
Every sort of status in that office
the status at the far counter
the status was the whole of the matter

The status of the whole thing

answers.why: earn the status 意为“挣得这一种地位”，1974 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一种地位做了一遍。
status 意为“地位；身份”，指那种地位本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
status 意为“地位；身份”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
status 意为“地位；身份”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
status 意为“地位、体面”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种体面就是那件事的全部。
status 意为“体面”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种地位，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
status 意为“地位；身份”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1979 年这一种成了卷宗里的一行。
status 意为“地位之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的地位之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
status 意为“地位；身份”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一种，1981 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一种。
status 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，地位是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的地位。
